decision: Keep pre-experiment production policy. No-hold, rolling refill and demand-first candidates were not adopted; retain opt-in fixture and evidence.
environment: macOS ARM64; Rust nightly 2026-06-21; dev/test unoptimized; real Foyer/SST decoding/iterator.next; synthetic 2ms physical InMemObjectStore delay (Tokio timer, not precision S3 model).

method.work_model: busy CPU work followed by yield per block; row iteration and exact key/value checks remain real
method.early_stop: consume 5 blocks of a 32-block hard bound; next() has loaded block 5 when loop exits; discarded counter is retained speculative handles, not all unused decoded data
method.caches: cold memory-only Foyer between trials; separate warm-cache check; disk engine behavior covered by existing regressions, not modeled here
method.scope: leaf SstableIterator and SstableStore.get, not entire executor/LSM/MVCC or SF10
method.summaries: median of per-invocation aggregate statistics; final AB is before/after then after/before; fractional median GET totals can occur across two runs. Tail percentiles have small sample counts and are descriptive only.

variants.baseline: existing first-IO one-yield plug; fixed window; neighbors registered before demand
variants.nohold: read_batch returns None; fixed window and original order
variants.demand-first: nohold plus demand registered first without plug
variants.rolling: nohold plus demand first and half-window refill, same retained count/byte caps
variants.rolling-plug: original order and plug plus half-window refill
variants.demand-plug: demand registered first in same plug, fixed window
variants.final-ab-after: cleaned-up demand-plug candidate; registration/wait kept in existing boxed new-window future; not adopted

validation: All experimental runs verified keys/values. Final candidate also asserted retained count/byte bounds. Warm scans issued zero GETs. 43 object-store tests passed across sandbox run + authorized loopback rerun, 12 iterator + 11 SstableStore + 1 backfill routing tests passed on candidate; restored production iterator and store tests rerun. No new correctness bug established; scheduling tradeoffs observed. Retained source was rebuilt and its real-iterator plus warm-cache experiments both passed; retained seek future is 1000 bytes.
